changes.catalogue-fields: LTspice's catalogue fields (mfg=, Vceo=, …) removed: ngspice refuses them, the others ignore them
changes.renamed: the .model renamed DUT, the name the bench's netlists use

.temp 25

.end

.options reltol=1e-4
